tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Searches every connected mailbox (sender, subject, preview), newest first. Operators: from:, subject:, before:YYYY-MM-DD, after:YYYY-MM-DD; the rest is free text. Deleted emails are not returned.

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: One email in full: sender, recipients, date, subject, plain-text body, attachment names, folder and BumbleBox classification.

tools.name: list_to_answer
tools.description: Received emails BumbleBox classified as needing a reply and still in the inbox, newest first.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Contacts BumbleBox knows from the mail history (name, address, organization domain, exchange counts, last exchanges, VIP mark, note), matched on name, address or domain.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: The folders of each connected mailbox, as last synced. Trash, spam, sent and drafts are left out.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: Events of the connected Google calendars between two dates (default: the next 7 days, at most 62 days).

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.description: Saves the text as the reply draft of a received email, from the mailbox that received it. Nothing is sent: the draft waits in BumbleBox (Pilotage › prepared replies) until the user reviews it and clicks Send. Saving again replaces the previous draft of the same email.

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Replies to the sender of one received email, and only to them (no Cc, no Bcc, no attachment), from the mailbox that received it. What happens next is the level the user set in BumbleBox for this kind of reply: a draft, a reply waiting for one tap (the default), or a reply that leaves after a delay t

tools.name: archive_email
tools.description: Moves one inbox email to its mailbox's archive folder, on the mail server too. Undone by restore_to_inbox. Nothing is deleted.

tools.name: move_email
tools.description: Moves one inbox email to an existing folder of the same mailbox (see list_folders), on the mail server too. No folder is created. Undone by restore_to_inbox.

tools.name: trash_email
tools.description: Moves one inbox email to its mailbox's trash when BumbleBox certifies it as noise (spam, newsletter, promotion, with a unanimous safety vote and no known contact or action word). Any other email is not moved: it becomes a proposal the user confirms in one tap in BumbleBox. Never a permanent deletion

tools.name: restore_to_inbox
tools.description: Moves an archived, filed or trashed email back to the inbox, on the mail server too.

tools.name: list_missions
tools.description: The user's prospection campaigns (missions), most recently active first, with the number of drafts waiting, emails sent and prospects who replied.

tools.name: list_campaign_drafts
tools.description: The drafts of one campaign that wait for the user to validate them in BumbleBox (recipient, subject, plain-text body, sender), newest first, with the true totals.

tools.name: list_replies_to_validate
tools.description: Replies received on campaigns that still need the user: prepared reply drafts waiting for validation, and replies with no answer yet (with the stored AI triage: kind, summary, whether a human is needed).

tools.name: create_campaign_draft
tools.description: Writes one draft inside an existing campaign, to one recipient (added to the campaign list if new), from the campaign's sender. Nothing is sent: the draft waits for the user to validate the campaign send in BumbleBox.

tools.name: update_campaign_draft
tools.description: Changes the subject, body or recipient of a draft that is still a draft. Nothing is sent, and a draft the user already validated cannot be changed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_emails, get_email, list_to_answer, list_missions · Private data: search_contacts, trash_email · Public sink: get_email, draft_reply, send_reply, archive_email, move_email, trash_email, restore_to_inbox, create_campaign_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_emails, get_email, list_to_answer, list_missions · Private data: search_contacts, trash_email · Public sink: get_email, draft_reply, send_reply, archive_email, move_email, trash_email, restore_to_inbox, create_campaign_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
